title: Beyond the keyboard
lead: A little about who I am when I'm not at work.

interests.title: On two wheels
interests.text: I'm a biker. I love a long road ride as much as a rough adventure trail, and planning the route is half the fun.

interests.title: Video games
interests.text: Gaming is how I switch off. My all-time favourite is Need for Speed: Most Wanted.

interests.title: Diecast collecting
interests.text: A newer hobby: collecting good diecast models and enjoying the small details in each one.

interests.title: Places, food and people
interests.text: I love exploring new places, trying local food, and talking to new people to learn about them and where they come from.

people_lead: What that curiosity looks like day to day, at work and outside it:
people: Easy to talk to, and happy to start the conversation with someone new.
The person you can message when you're stuck: a bug, a deployment, or just a second pair of eyes.
Curious by habit. I like understanding how a place, a person or a system works before I jump in.
Patient and calm when things get urgent, and glad to stay with a problem until it is sorted.
Someone who shares what I learn, through notes, documentation and a quick walkthrough.
A good teammate on a long ride or a long release: I look out for the people around me.
